description:
Discharge patient Maria Santos from her current admitted visit in HospitalRun. 

1. Locate patient Maria Santos (ID: p1-200001).
2. Open her current 'Admitted' visit (started Jan 10, 2025).
3. Edit the visit to change the Status to 'Discharged'.
4. Set the Discharge Date (End Date) to '01/17/2025'.
5. Save the visit record.
